title: Reuse a component
summary: Nuxt can auto-import components from its components folder.
introduction: Nuxt can auto-import components from its components folder. Your task: Render two BookCard components with different titles.
learningObjectives: Render two BookCard components with different titles.
Explain the example for reuse a component

blocks.text: Nuxt can auto-import components from its components folder. A component can receive props just like other Vue components.
Use a Nuxt 3 project for these file paths. Examples go in the files named in comments. Remove the starter welcome screen and use NuxtPage in app.vue. Nuxt code needs its own build tool.

items: `defineProps` declares values supplied by a parent component. Treat those values as inputs.

blocks.text: The books page shows the auto-imported BookCard with its title.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use the expected components folder and component name. A file in an unrelated folder is not automatically discovered.

blocks.text: Render two BookCard components with different titles.
